notes.title: Dog Days of Summer 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

So this is the Harper update. It is recommended that you start a new save due to bugs and failed switches.

I was planning on having everything up to the party done by this update but honestly the writing for this kinda kicked my butt. While in concept it was easy just three sticky notes, but in practice it too a lot of work.

As previously stated this was a large update in terms of writing, well over 20k words. Only a lot of that is to account for different choices. However I will say I am proud that this did what it set out to do and was able to successfully cross all the paths. So no matter what you did to help Evaline you can have all option available with Harper. It was not easy and probably a little heavy handed in some places.

But at the end of the day you have the option to

date harper

be trained by harper

or do nothing with harper

some of the paths will require you to be blackmailed while sometimes you can do it willingly depending on how you helped Evaline. There was only so much I could do narratively.

Though while you can choose to not do stuff with Harper depending on your actions she might seek revenge for slipping out of her grasp.
